run_densepose_inference_on_image: run end-to-end DensePose inference on a single image or folder of images using detectron
run_inference_with_config_and_weights: run inference on images using a config YAML file and model weights pickle file
parse_inference_cli_args: parse command line arguments for cfg file, weights, output directory, image extension, and image path
visualize_detection_results_as_pdf: visualize detected boxes, segmentations, keypoints, and body meshes as PDF output files
initialize_detectron_model_from_weights: initialize a detectron model from a weights file using the config and cache URL utilities
